summary: Iteration 47 — retest of iter_46 HIGH-priority pantry-id spread-order bug + deferred backup/restore + offline persistence sweep. PANTRY FIX VERIFIED (2 items with real `pantry_*` ids, 0 undefined, 0 React key warnings, delete-one keeps the other, survives reload). Offline persistence PARTIAL: notes/settings/company-name persist across reload; LANGUAGE DOES NOT PERSIST (Spanish reverts to English after reload — regression). Theme toggle click did not visibly flip .dark class in headless run — inconclusive. Backup export DOWNLOADS the JSON file correctly with proper shape (version 1.1, app='Iron Rabbit', exported_at, data.notes/settings/templates/files) BUT the UI shows a misleading 'Export failed' error toast because BackupRestoreModal.jsx accesses `payload.counts.notes` which does not exist on the export payload. ui_bugs.issue: Import rejects EVERY valid backup with 'Not an Iron Rabbit backup file' — validator compares payload.app to 'IronRabbit' but exportAllData writes 'Iron Rabbit' (with space). Restore/import flow is 100% broken. Blocks Google Play launch use-case of migrating to a new phone.

Success toast crashes on `payload.counts.notes` (counts field is not produced by StorageService.exportAllData) → caught → shows misleading 'Export failed' error toast even though the .json file DID download and is well-formed. Users will believe backup failed.

Interface mismatch: modal calls importAllData(payload, mode) and reads summary.notesRestored/filesRestored, but importAllData ignores `mode` (always clears+overwrites) and returns {notes, templates, files}. Merge vs Replace choice does nothing; post-import toast would show 'undefined notes'.

Language change to Spanish (es) does NOT survive a page reload — after reload localStorage.i18nextLng is back to 'en'. Likely i18next-browser-languagedetector re-detecting browser lang on every mount, or setting only applied in memory. Reproduce: header globe → Español → reload → UI back in English.

integration_issues.issue: Contract mismatch: modal reads payload.counts.{notes,files}; service returns {version, app, exported_at, data:{notes,settings,templates,files}} with NO top-level counts key. Fix either add counts to exportAllData or read from data.notes.length in modal.
String constant mismatch — 'IronRabbit' vs 'Iron Rabbit'. Choose one and use everywhere; better yet, accept both for backward-compat.

rca_of_the_issue:
Backup export failure toast RCA: BackupRestoreModal.jsx:36 does `toast.success(`Exported ${payload.counts.notes} ...`)` — but StorageService.exportAllData returns {version, app, exported_at, data:{...}} with no `counts` field. Reading `.notes` of undefined throws TypeError, caught by the surrounding try/catch (line 37-41) which fires `toast.error('Export failed')`. The file HAS already been downloaded by that point (a.click at line 33), so the user sees 'Export failed' but the download succeeded — very confusing.

Backup import failure RCA: BackupRestoreModal.jsx:50 checks `payload?.app !== 'IronRabbit'` (no space) but exportAllData writes `app: 'Iron Rabbit'` (WITH space). Every valid backup fails validation with 'Not an Iron Rabbit backup file'. Fix by matching strings — recommend `payload?.app !== 'Iron Rabbit'` and also accepting legacy `'IronRabbit'` for forward-compat.

Language persistence RCA: verified localStorage.i18nextLng was 'es' before reload and 'en' after reload — the value did not survive. Root cause is either (a) LanguageDetector caches list omits 'localStorage', OR (b) navigator detection runs first and clobbers, OR (c) i18n.changeLanguage() is not committing to storage. Check /app/frontend/src/i18n/index.js LanguageDetector options — specifically `caches: ['localStorage']` and `order: ['localStorage', 'navigator', ...]`.
